dex.entry: The apex vane-beast: a tall, regal kin whose entire dorsal spine has become a bank of spinning turbine-blades, generating a tornado-like static field that blinds and staggers opponents. The windmill grew into a roaring turbine — impossible to touch without getting shocked.

art.silhouette: Upright digitigrade silhouette, dark storm-grey coat, a full spine-ridge of spinning vane-blades each trailing a spark arc, crackling eye-markings that pulse in sync with the vanes; imposing at 64px.
